scripts.dev: npm run build -w @teambrain/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @teambrain/api" "npm run dev -w @teambrain/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @teambrain/shared && npm run build -w @teambrain/api && npm run build -w @teambrain/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @teambrain/shared && npm run typecheck -w @teambrain/api && npm run typecheck -w @teambrain/web
scripts.reembed-memories: npm run build -w @teambrain/shared && npm run build -w @teambrain/api && node apps/api/dist/reembed-memories.js
